text:
I'm sorry for the worry. The policy information I have doesn't explain how weather holds work, so I can't say why your order was held or how long it will last. It does imply that a hold exists to protect plants from cold or heat in transit, which fits with freezing weather where you are. Cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee if you waive the hold.

If you share your order number (it looks like LF-123456), I can escalate this to a Support Lead to confirm the hold reason and expected ship date. Orders can also be changed or cancelled free from "My Orders" within 2 hours of ordering, but after that support can only try to intercept it, with no guarantee.
